title: ToolDescriptor
description: Uniform descriptor for every tool in the phonebot system: builtin, custom (bot-local), and MCP-provided. botd validates descriptors against this schema at registry load time; the app renders descriptors read-only.

id.description: Globally unique tool id, dotted namespace, e.g. "shell.run".

kind.description: builtin = shipped with botd; custom = bot-local skill tool; mcp = provided by a registered MCP server.

provider.description: Who serves the tool: core | botd | bot:<id> | mcp:<name>.

name.description: Model-facing name. Typically identical to id.

description.description: Model-facing description: what the tool does, when to use it, what it returns.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema object describing the tool's arguments. Enforced by botd at invoke time.

risk.description: Base risk tier. read+write = silent (trace chip); destructive+privileged = needs-approval; costly = spend-cap gated. May be escalated per-call via risk_rules, never lowered below privileged.

risk_rules.description: Optional per-call rules (condition → escalation) evaluated by botd before execution.

backends.description: Ordered backend names this tool can execute on (e.g. ["termux", "ssh"]). Resolver picks the first available.

phase.description: Build phase in which this tool ships. The registry exposes tools at or below the active phase.

default_allowed.description: Whether the tool is enabled by default before a human opts out in Settings → Capabilities → Tools.
